title: I tried Faceless YouTube Automation for 200 days
summary: Two hundred days running faceless YouTube channels: early viral luck, failed replication, freelancer problems, and more spent than earned.

assertions.quote: I realized this was far from automated not like software anyway

verdicts.note: Channel operators consistently report scripting, hiring, and managing editors as ongoing work.

assertions.quote: we've spent upwards of 7 to 10K and made back less than a fifth of that
there was no long-term value in going viral the value is in recurring viewers

verdicts.note: Trend-driven views churn; retention and returning viewers drive sustained channel revenue.

assertions.quote: these results that we got for the first two videos are quite unrealistic for beginners

verdicts.note: Some of Automators' featured 'client success stories' were actually undisclosed Empire employees, so the showcased successes were not ordinary students at all.

assertions.quote: she had all the video assets so no one else could replicate the work that she did

verdicts.note: A common complaint in outsourced creative work; frequency unmeasured.

assertions.quote: sneaky tricks to make money earned on YouTube much greater than what it actually is

verdicts.note: Consistent with earnings-claim patterns regulators have challenged; not measured for this niche.

assertions.quote: the opportunity does not lie in AdSense it lies in something else

verdicts.note: Creator income surveys show sponsorships and products outweigh AdSense for most channels, but this needs an audience first.

assertions.quote: I try affiliate marketing realized it's litered with false expectations
you can pay somebody to teach you and help you get up to speed I recommend the latter

verdicts.note: Good instruction speeds learning, but there is no evidence guru programs deliver it, and the speaker sells one.
Good instruction does speed skill acquisition, but paid online business courses have no independent evidence of better outcomes and many are sold by the people promoting them.
